notes: Base embedded struct adds created_at/updated_at/deleted_at and created_by/updated_by/deleted_by (soft delete) to most tables.
Only db/migrations/sku_performance_data.sql exists as DDL; every other table is known from GORM models, so column types and indexes are as declared in struct tags.

Roughly 150 Go structs live in model/entity; this file lists the persisted ones plus the main report read models. Remaining structs are JSON column types (e.g. Budget, DynamicBidding, TargetExpression) or response DTOs.
There is no tenant or seller-account column anywhere: tenancy is the profile id (one table, many profiles, one company).
